jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
This employer is hiring for a Data Analyst to join a sales strategy and operations team, focusing on driving productivity and effectiveness for a commercial sales organization. The role involves partnering closely with sales leadership to optimize processes, deliver actionable business insights, and shape strategic planning.

The Role

• Execute on a standard weekly, monthly, and quarterly operational cadence, including forecasting and business reviews
• Analyze sales and revenue data to build models, provide strategic recommendations, and shape annual planning processes
• Develop and manage project plans, segment-wide operational processes, and sales territory development
• Build, manage, and maintain centralized reporting tools and dashboards to drive data-driven decision-making

What You'll Need

• 3–5 years of work experience in sales strategy and operations, business analytics, management consulting, or related domains
• Strong analytical skills, a structured approach to problem-solving, and a user-first collaborative mindset
• Experience with CRM systems, intermediate to advanced SQL, and strong spreadsheet modeling skills
• Proven ability to work with large datasets and translate complex technical insights into practical recommendations for non-technical audiences

What's On Offer

• Competitive salary
• Opportunities to drive strategic impact and shape business outcomes at the ground level
• Collaborative work environment focused on professional growth and development
